story_title: Valkyrie Down: The Ruins of Asgard

intro.text: Your exploration frigate Valkyrie crashes into the emerald fjords of Planet Yggdrasil. Massive alien dreadnought ruins lie half-buried in mist and bioluminescent moss. Ancient AI guardians modeled after Norse deities awaken from slumber as your survival pod opens.

choices.text: Explore the Temple of Odin carved into the crashed dreadnought hull
Salvage your frigate's plasma weapon battery from the pod wreckage

salvage_weapon.text: You salvage a Runed Energy Core that allows your plasma weapon to channel alien rune energy.

choices.text: Equip the Runed Energy Core and proceed to the Temple of Odin

odin_temple.text: Inside the Temple, the ancient AI construct ODIN-9 materializes as a towering 3D hologram of light and steel: 'Mortal traveler, state your intent. Will you trigger Ragnarok, or earn your ascension?'

choices.text: Use the Runed Energy Core to interface directly with ODIN-9 mainframe
Initiate the emergency Ragnarok purge protocol to destroy all AI constructs
Request ODIN-9 to repair your Valkyrie frigate jump drive to return home

ending_ascension.text:
ENDING 1: ASCENSION
Your Runed Energy Core merges your consciousness with ODIN-9. You transcend mortal form, becoming the ruler of Yggdrasil's alien AI pantheon.

ending_ragnarok.text:
ENDING 2: RAGNAROK PROTOCOL
A colossal shockwave shatters ODIN-9 and obliterates the ancient dreadnought ruins. The AI gods fall, leaving planet Yggdrasil in primitive peace.

ending_return.text:
ENDING 3: RETURN HOME
ODIN-9 grants your request. The Valkyrie frigate jump drive roars back to life, launching you into warp speed back to Earth with tales of alien gods.
